scripts.task_it: Scrivi uno script che crea un nuovo chunk con le sole foto che vedono l'area selezionata (`polygon`).
scripts.task_en: Write a script that makes a new chunk with only the photos that see the selected area (`polygon`).
scripts.example:
from pyarchinit_photogrammetry.engine.patches import photos_for_area

ring = np.asarray(polygon.exterior.coords)
rows = photos_for_area(chunk, ring, limit=100_000)
keys = {r["key"] for r in rows if r.get("coverage", 0) > 0}
useful = [c for c in chunk.cameras if c.key in keys]
new = doc.duplicate_chunk(chunk, cameras=useful, label=chunk.label + " - area")
print(new.label, len(new.cameras))

scripts.task_it: Scrivi uno script che disattiva le foto del chunk attivo che non vedono l'area selezionata (`polygon`).
scripts.task_en: Write a script that disables the photos of the active chunk that do not see the selected area (`polygon`).
scripts.check: len(doc.chunks) == 1 and 0 < sum(c.enabled for c in chunk.cameras) < len(chunk.cameras)
scripts.example:
from pyarchinit_photogrammetry.engine.patches import photos_for_area

rows = photos_for_area(chunk, np.asarray(polygon.exterior.coords), limit=100_000)
keys = {r["key"] for r in rows if r.get("coverage", 0) > 0}
n = chunk.set_cameras_enabled([c for c in chunk.cameras if c.key not in keys], False)
print("disabled", n)

scripts.task_it: Scrivi uno script che classifica la nuvola densa e poi rifà il DEM con i soli punti del terreno (classe 2).
scripts.task_en: Write a script that classifies the dense cloud and then builds the DEM again from the ground points only (class 2).
scripts.example:
from pyarchinit_photogrammetry.ai.classify import classify_chunk

classify_chunk(chunk)
path = chunk.build_dem(classes=[2])
print(path)

scripts.task_it: Scrivi uno script che esporta in LAS i soli punti del terreno (classe 2) della nuvola densa nel file classe2.las nella cartella del progetto; se la nuvola non è classificata, classificala prima.
scripts.task_en: Write a script that exports the ground points only (class 2) of the dense cloud to LAS, the file classe2.las in the folder of the project; when the cloud is not classified, classify it first.
scripts.example:
from pathlib import Path
from pyarchinit_photogrammetry.ai.classify import classify_chunk

if 2 not in chunk.point_classes():
    classify_chunk(chunk)
out = chunk.export_point_cloud(Path(doc.path).parent / "classe2.las", classes=[2])
print(out)
